releaseScope: 3.3.0 P1: rule R17 adds the prompt-injection budget. It estimates, per Agent and per scenario, the context the runner would deliver (Agent prompt + policies + every injected Skill document) against a declared windowProfile, and attributes the crossing to the two engine behaviours that cause it: a pinned Pack whose member Skills join every stage, and a scenario that names no Skills and therefore falls back to every declared Skill. Closes the output-schema version constant that 0.5.1/0.5.2 carried as 0.3.0, and aligns this release's own workflow.yaml self-declared version (the R2 identity error the 0.5.2 scan reports against itself). Adds six R17 tests.
openDeferred: Publication is not adoption: no current pointer, platform configuration or platform default is changed by this release (BP-2, red line 5).

The measured context ceiling of each platform is not proven by this release; windowProfile is read from the Agent manifest and defaults to 256k, and the qoder platform attestation is recorded separately in qoder/bridge/capabilities.json.
The token figure is a declared formula (1.1 per CJK character, 1 per 3.6 other characters), not a claim about any model's real tokenizer; no tokenizer is installed on this host.
